purpose: Distilled LoRA scale-sweep gate results for ONE LoRA (e.g. nsfw-master). Each line is one durable insight: the optimal scale (metric), the under/over-activation failure modes (avoid), and the known passing range (lever). Accumulated across gate runs via the extract-knowledge phase.
produced_by: extract-knowledge phase in lora-quality-gate.js (Persist). The sonnet agent distills the sweep into metric/avoid/lever records, merging with existing records by id and bumping evidence_count.
consumed_by: load-knowledge phase in lora-quality-gate.js (Knowledge) — injects active records' digest into the run so the gate can prefer previously-confirmed scales. Also scripts/check-workflow-patterns.mjs (drift guard) and scripts/workflow-knowledge-manifest.mjs (MANIFEST.md matrix).

record_schema.name: type
record_schema.desc: metric | avoid | lever (mirrors the canonical workflow-knowledge type enum for these three).

record_schema.name: lora
record_schema.desc: LoRA instance name this record pertains to, e.g. nsfw-master.

record_schema.name: value
record_schema.desc: metric records only: the optimal scale (e.g. 0.8).

record_schema.name: note
record_schema.desc: Human-readable finding, including per-run pass/fail breakdown (Run 2 / Run 3 ...) for traceability.

record_schema.name: failing_scales
record_schema.desc: avoid records only: scales that failed the gate, merged (unique) across all runs.

record_schema.name: passing_scales
record_schema.desc: lever records only: scales that passed the gate in any run, merged (unique) across runs.

record_schema.name: consistently_passing
record_schema.desc: lever records only: scales that passed in ALL runs — the safe-default candidates.

record_schema.name: evidence_count
record_schema.desc: Number of gate runs contributing to this record (the accumulation/version key).

record_schema.name: updated
record_schema.desc: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last update.

findings: nsfw-master: optimal scale is 0.8 — the only scale passing in BOTH run 2 and run 3. Response is non-monotonic (1.2 passed run 2 but failed run 3; 1.0 the reverse), so boundary scales must be re-verified each run. Under-activation is the dominant failure mode, dominant at scales < 0.65 but also possible at high scales.
notes: DIFFERENT artifact from the canonical .claude/workflows/*.knowledge.jsonl (the 12-key workflow-knowledge schema used by the self-improve/review-optimize family). This file is per-lora scale-sweep metric knowledge — its type enum (metric/avoid/lever) overlaps the canonical one, but its data keys (lora/value/failing_scales/passing_scales/consistently_passing/evidence_count/updated) do NOT. The records were RE-NORMALIZED 2026-06-20: the extract-knowledge agent had been emitting run-specific top-level keys (failing_scales_run2, failing_scales_run3, passing_scales_runN) that drift every run and are impossible to declare in a stable schema; they were merged into the stable failing_scales / passing_scales arrays above (per-run detail is preserved in `note`). ROOT CAUSE still open: the extract-knowledge prompt in lora-quality-gate.js gives the agent id/type guidance but NO fixed field schema, so a future run may re-emit run-N keys and re-trigger drift. Lasting fix = either (a) pin a schema in that prompt and fold per-run results into structured fields, or (b) migrate this file onto the canonical 12-key schema. Tracked as a next-iteration TODO.
